messages:
Priya: Quick sync  'launch-floorplan' request. Product wants steady 2.5k rps @ ~230ms p95, burst to 6k for ~15m. Need to lock prewarm strategy, reserved burst plan, KMS onboarding, canary shape, and rollback triggers. cc @Ethan @Maya @Leo @Sam @Anika
Ethan: For p95 stability we should reserve warm slots and run KV/prefix prefill. Autoscale + predictive fill is OK later but risky for day-1.
Maya: Runtime prefers a 10min prewarm with top-90 prefix warmlist + KV priming. Propose fallback model 'compact-lite-q6' for heavy degradation and a per-tenant canary flag.
Leo: Infra can reserve a 2-node burst pool if we commit counts ASAP. Scheduler requires 48h notice. If KMS/HSM is needed open onboarding now  rotation needs a maintenance window.
Sam: Security: KMS fine. Need a 30-45m threat-model and an IaC PR adding least-privilege key roles. Confirm telemetry scrubs PII before export.
Anika: PM asks for a short customer-facing table showing expected latency vs quality when fallback fires. That helps support scripts.
Ethan: Rollout asks: tenant-scoped canaries + percent ramp. Also please document the expected quality delta for the fallback model (semantic-top5 vs primary).
Maya: Will attach eval curve and sample prompts. Observability will track: gen p95, error rate, semantic top-5 match, token-cost delta. Will add synthetic probes every 5m.
infra-bot: reservation created: req-12877 (2x burst nodes). ETA approval: 2024-09-03T10:00Z
Priya: Action items: Priya -> open KMS ticket (#TICKET-8110) and own customer comms; Ethan -> add canary flag + doc fallback behavior by Tue; Maya -> publish prefix warmlist + attach evals; Leo -> confirm reservation counts + cost estimate; Sam -> schedule threat-model within 48h; Anika -> draft customer-facing quality table. If no objections by EOD I'll lock scope.
